instrumentation: Appends a read-only reference to existing sessions module objects; no API/function behavior replacement. Inputs use fill/Tab, checkbox, mouse, or trusted browser touch contacts.

definitions.name: Relay

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: GPIO high energizes relay; GPIO low releases it. DIN is the yellow wire. The unit has no protocol address; relay contact state is derived from the guest-driven GPIO.
gaps: Electrical contact timing, load switching and physical isolation require separate hardware evidence.

claims: guest driver transaction path and encoding
reference for implementation; linked document content is not claimed to have been independently reviewed
